about.title: Taft Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Taft is a small town, and when someone dies in a crash here, the loss ripples out through Rt 33, 6th Street and the neighborhoods around Kern Street in a way that larger cities rarely feel. In the most recent final crash year, 2025, public records show 22 injury collisions in Taft, 31 people hurt, and 2 lives lost. A wrongful death claim is one of the tools California gives the families left behind. It is a civil action, entirely separate from anything the district attorney may pursue, and it exists to address what the death cost the people who depended on that person: funeral and burial expenses, the income and support they would have provided, and the love, companionship and guidance that cannot be replaced. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Kern County families with an independent wrongful death attorney who works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You do not need to have anything figured out before you reach out.

whyChoose.title: Why Taft Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most California wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Getting connected promptly means those dates are tracked from the start.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, and our connection service is free. Your family can pursue funeral costs, lost financial support and the loss of companionship without paying anything up front.

items.question: My relative died in a collision on Rt 33 outside Taft and the driver is facing charges. Do we have to wait for the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, separate from whatever the Kern County District Attorney decides to do. The criminal case is about punishment; the civil claim is about the losses your family absorbed. An attorney can move forward on your claim while the criminal matter is still pending, and the outcome of one does not decide the other.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives first priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If there are none, certain other dependents and heirs may have standing. Because families are rarely simple, an independent attorney will look at your specific situation and explain who can be part of the claim.

items.question: How long do we have to act after a death in Taft?
items.answer: Generally, two years from the date of death. That period shrinks considerably if a government entity, such as a public agency responsible for a roadway, may share responsibility, because a formal claim must be presented to that entity first on a much shorter timeline. Reaching out sooner rather than later protects your family's options.
